principles: Independent daily and weekly chapters, never add long dependency lines to main story chapters.
Rotate among roleplay delivery, gathering, farming, fishing, crafting, exploration, trade and verified mob tasks.
No forced purchase of expensive Waystones, plushies or other rare shop goods.
Daily tasks should be achievable by new players; weekly tasks have more substantial scope.
Reusable task completion must not duplicate any one-off merchant, story, or rank reward.
Group/team payout duplication must be tested on server before activation.
Do not invent boss IDs, mod locations or dungeons; only confirmed modpack mobs/structures.
Adjust coin/item reward quantities after testing MiguelEconomy shop price balance.
